verdict.rationale: Honeycomb is documented exclusively as a hosted SaaS product (pricing plans, cloud ingestion via OTLP, cloud UI features); no evidence pack item mentions self-hosting, on-prem deployment, architecture diagrams for a self-managed stack, or an upgrade/versioning path for running Honeycomb yourself. Since self-hosted observability stacks are a legitimate category (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana), the axis applies, but there is no evidence Honeycomb supports it.
